> [Laura Albert](https://engineering.wisc.edu/directory/profile/laura-albert), professor and the David Gustafson Department Chair of Industrial & Systems Engineering at the UW–Madison College of Engineering discusses how artificial intelligence is changing the American business landscape. This is the 6th installment in our webinar series about AI.
